name: helios_to_lucid_rect_v1
image_frame: Lucid raw frame (2880x1860, not rotated) undistorted with calibration/lucid_intrinsics_colmap.json to its 'rectified' pinhole K
depth_frame: Helios camera frame, millimetres (Coord3D_ABCY16 X, Y, Z)
model: pinhole, no distortion: [u v 1]^T ~ K_rect (dR_seq R X + t); dR_seq from helios_to_lucid_sag.json (rotation vector, degrees), identity when unverified
note: The Helios sags against the Lucid as the rig tilts (pitch up to ~6 deg looking up), so one fixed transform cannot fit every sequence: R, t are the rig's pose, helios_to_lucid_sag.json the per-sequence deviation.
